title: LLM empowered smart hydrology
summary: ZTE reports approximately 30% less hydrology report-writing time and 20% better line-drawing efficiency in its operational hydrology application.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZTE describes an operational hydrology model with the Changjiang Hydrological Bureau as a partner. It reports shorter report writing, faster thalweg drawing, and prediction and query accuracy figures. The system is intended to support water management and flood planning. Specific flood interventions and prevented losses remain undocumented.
purpose: Improve hydrological analysis, reporting, and planning.

ratings.reason: The operational ZTE/Changjiang Hydrological Bureau case reports approximately 30% less report-writing time.
No flood-response decision or prevented loss is documented.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: LLM empowered smart hydrology

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: A hydrology model reports faster operational reporting
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
